token.info: A Control D API token of type Write.

redact_paths.info: Mask install-root / venv / home prefixes in logged paths (<unshackle>, <venv>, ~).

session_ttl.info: Seconds a remote session can stay idle before it expires.

tiers.info: Named settings that users entries reference by name (see below).

users.info: Per-user API keys and their allowlists (see below).

theme.info: Named colour theme for all CLI output: banner, logs, progress bars, and help screens.
